scope: East & Southeast Texas (Smith, Gregg, Angelina, Nacogdoches, Jefferson counties; Tyler, Longview, Lufkin, Beaumont, Port Arthur)

records.name: East Texas Food Bank
records.description_en: Regional food bank that supplies food pantries, produce distributions and other feeding programs across East Texas. Its online Find Food tool shows the pantry nearest you.
records.description_es: Banco de comida regional que surte a despensas, repartos de frutas y verduras y otros programas de comida en el Este de Texas. En su página "Find Food" puede buscar la despensa más cercana a usted.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in the food bank's East Texas service area who needs food can use the Find Food tool to locate help.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona que necesite comida en el área que atiende el banco de comida puede usar la herramienta "Find Food" para encontrar ayuda.
records.how_to_apply: Go to the Find Food page and enter your address, city or ZIP code to see pantries and food distributions near you, or call the food bank.
records.how_to_apply_es: Entre a la página "Find Food" y escriba su dirección, ciudad o código postal para ver despensas y repartos de comida cerca de usted. También puede llamar al banco de comida.
records.notes: Serves 26 East Texas counties (per the Find Food page). Runs resource centers in Tyler, Longview and Lufkin.

records.name: Tyler Resource Center (Food Pantry and Benefits Help)
records.description_en: Client food pantry with shelf-stable food, meat and fresh produce. Staff also help you apply for SNAP, Medicaid, TANF, CHIP and other programs, and offer utility assistance and nutrition classes.
records.description_es: Despensa de comida con alimentos no perecederos, carne y frutas y verduras frescas. El personal también le ayuda a solicitar SNAP (estampillas), Medicaid, TANF, CHIP y otros programas, y ofrece ayuda con servicios públicos y clases de nutrición.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Households at or below the TEFAP (The Emergency Food Assistance Program) income guidelines, plus people going through a crisis. All are welcome regardless of where they live. You may visit the pantry twice a month.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Hogares con ingresos dentro de las guías de TEFAP (Programa de Asistencia de Alimentos de Emergencia), y personas que pasan por una crisis. Todos son bienvenidos, sin importar dónde vivan. Puede visitar la despensa dos veces al mes.
documents_needed: No papers required: you verbally share name, address, household size, date of birth and monthly income
records.how_to_apply: Walk in during pantry hours and tell staff your name, address, household size, date of birth and monthly income. Benefits application help is by appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya en el horario de la despensa y dígale al personal su nombre, dirección, número de personas en su hogar, fecha de nacimiento e ingreso mensual. No necesita papeles. La ayuda con solicitudes de beneficios es con cita.
records.notes: Pantry use limited to twice per month. Benefits Assistance is by appointment.

records.name: Longview Resource Center (Food Pantry and Benefits Help)
records.description_en: Food pantry with shelf-stable food, meat and fresh produce. Staff also help with SNAP, Medicaid, Medicare, TANF and CHIP applications, and offer utility assistance and nutrition education when available.
records.description_es: Despensa de comida con alimentos no perecederos, carne y frutas y verduras frescas. El personal también ayuda con solicitudes de SNAP, Medicaid, Medicare, TANF y CHIP, y ofrece ayuda con servicios públicos y clases de nutrición cuando hay.
records.eligibility_summary_en: All are welcome. Serves households at or below TEFAP income guidelines and people in crisis. You may visit the pantry twice a month.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Todos son bienvenidos. Atiende a hogares con ingresos dentro de las guías de TEFAP y a personas en crisis. Puede visitar la despensa dos veces al mes.
documents_needed: No papers required: you tell staff your household information at the front desk
records.how_to_apply: Walk in during open hours through the Signal Hill Drive entrance and give your household information at the front desk. The center is on Longview Transit Route 1.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya en el horario abierto y entre por Signal Hill Drive. En la recepción dé la información de su hogar. El centro está en la Ruta 1 de Longview Transit.
records.notes: Reachable by Longview Transit Route 1. Pantry visits limited to twice monthly.

records.name: Deep East Texas Resource Center (Lufkin Food Pantry and Benefits Help)
records.description_en: Food pantry with shelf-stable food, meat and fresh produce, plus help applying for SNAP, Medicaid, Medicare, TANF and CHIP. Also offers utility assistance and nutrition education when available.
records.description_es: Despensa de comida con alimentos no perecederos, carne y frutas y verduras frescas, y ayuda para solicitar SNAP, Medicaid, Medicare, TANF y CHIP. También ofrece ayuda con servicios públicos y clases de nutrición cuando hay.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Households at or below TEFAP income guidelines, plus people going through a crisis. All are welcome regardless of where they live. You may visit the pantry twice a month.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Hogares con ingresos dentro de las guías de TEFAP y personas que pasan por una crisis. Todos son bienvenidos, sin importar dónde vivan. Puede visitar la despensa dos veces al mes.
documents_needed: No papers required: you tell staff your household information
records.how_to_apply: Walk in during open hours or call the center.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya en el horario abierto o llame al centro.
records.notes: Located in Lufkin; the page says it welcomes all regardless of where they live, so Nacogdoches residents can also use it.

records.name: Southeast Texas Food Bank
records.description_en: Regional food bank for Southeast Texas. It helps you find the nearest food pantry or other emergency food source in your county.
records.description_es: Banco de comida regional del Sureste de Texas. Le ayuda a encontrar la despensa u otro lugar de comida de emergencia más cercano en su condado.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Residents of its 8-county service area (Hardin, Jasper, Jefferson, Newton, Orange, Polk, Sabine and Tyler counties).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que viven en sus 8 condados: Hardin, Jasper, Jefferson, Newton, Orange, Polk, Sabine y Tyler.
records.how_to_apply: Call the food bank or use the Get Help section of its website, which lists partner agencies by county.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al banco de comida o use la sección "Get Help" de su página web, donde hay una lista de agencias por condado.
records.notes: Toll free (844) 356-9084. Serves Hardin, Jasper, Jefferson, Newton, Orange, Polk, Sabine and Tyler counties.

records.name: Market to HOPE Food Pantry
records.description_en: Client-choice food pantry where you shop for groceries including fresh produce, protein and dairy. Open six days a week with evening hours for working families.
records.description_es: Despensa donde usted escoge sus propios alimentos, incluyendo frutas y verduras frescas, proteína y lácteos. Abre seis días a la semana, con horario en la tarde para familias que trabajan.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-to-moderate income households facing food insecurity, and people with a temporary hardship. Open to all regardless of religion.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Hogares de ingresos bajos o moderados que no tienen suficiente comida, y personas con un problema económico temporal. Abierto a todos sin importar su religión.
records.how_to_apply: Call the program or the main Catholic Charities line to learn how to sign up.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al programa o a la línea principal de Catholic Charities para saber cómo inscribirse.
records.hours: Open six days a week, including evening hours (call for exact times)
records.notes: Shopping help is available for people with physical disabilities. A second location is in Winnie (902 E. 3rd Street). Main Catholic Charities line: (409) 924-4400.

records.name: Hospitality Center Daily Hot Meal
records.description_en: Serves a free, freshly made hot meal every day of the year in Port Arthur.
records.description_es: Sirve una comida caliente, recién hecha y gratis todos los días del año en Port Arthur.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in need, regardless of age, race, gender or religion, including seniors on fixed incomes, working people, people with disabilities and people experiencing homelessness.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona que lo necesite, sin importar su edad, raza, sexo o religión. Incluye personas mayores con ingresos fijos, personas que trabajan, personas con discapacidad y personas sin hogar.
records.how_to_apply: Come to the Hospitality Center. Call ahead to ask about meal times.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya al Hospitality Center. Llame antes para preguntar a qué hora sirven la comida.
records.hours: Open 7 days a week, 365 days a year (call for meal time)
records.notes: Main Catholic Charities line: (409) 924-4400. Meal times are not listed on the website.

records.name: Energy Assistance (CEAP) - Smith County
records.organization: Greater East Texas Community Action Program (GETCAP)
records.description_en: Helps low-income households pay electric and gas bills through the state Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP), with case management and energy education.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de bajos ingresos a pagar la luz y el gas por medio del programa estatal de asistencia de energía (CEAP). También dan apoyo de un trabajador de casos y consejos para ahorrar energía.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income households. Priority goes to households with high energy use, children age 5 or younger, seniors, and people with disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias de bajos ingresos. Tienen prioridad los hogares que usan mucha energía, que tienen niños de 5 años o menos, personas mayores o personas con discapacidad.
records.how_to_apply: Schedule an appointment online, download a paper application (English or Spanish), or text to have an application mailed or emailed to you. You can also call your county office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga una cita por internet, descargue una solicitud en papel (en inglés o español), o mande un mensaje de texto para que le envíen la solicitud por correo o email. También puede llamar a la oficina de su condado.
records.notes: Processing can take 60-90 days after all documents are received; keep paying your bills while you wait. Text your name and county to 936-553-0318 to check status. GETCAP main line (800) 621-5746. Office hours and income limits were not stated on the GETCAP pages.

records.name: Weatherization Assistance Program
records.organization: Greater East Texas Community Action Program (GETCAP)
records.description_en: Makes homes more energy efficient to help lower utility bills, for example by insulating attics, caulking cracks around windows and doors, and adding weatherstripping.
records.description_es: Hace que las casas usen menos energía para bajar las cuentas de luz y gas. Por ejemplo, ponen aislamiento en el ático, sellan grietas en ventanas y puertas y ponen burletes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income households in GETCAP's service area. Exact income limits were not stated on the page.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias de bajos ingresos en el área que atiende GETCAP. La página no dice los límites exactos de ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Download a paper application (English or Spanish), apply online through the GETCAP client portal, or contact your local GETCAP office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue una solicitud en papel (en inglés o español), solicite por internet en el portal de clientes de GETCAP, o comuníquese con la oficina de GETCAP de su área.
records.notes: Offices: Tyler (903) 962-2670; Longview (903) 758-5674; Lufkin (936) 639-4787 (weatherization line); Beaumont (409) 247-6270. Email wxprograminfo@get-cap.org. Income limits and office hours were not stated.

records.name: Head Start and Early Head Start
records.organization: Greater East Texas Community Action Program (GETCAP)
records.description_en: Free early learning, child care and family support program for young children from low-income families, with centers in Tyler and Nacogdoches. Early Head Start serves babies and toddlers and pregnant families.
records.description_es: Programa gratis de aprendizaje temprano, cuidado infantil y apoyo familiar para niños pequeños de familias de bajos ingresos, con centros en Tyler y Nacogdoches. Early Head Start atiende a bebés, niños pequeños y mujeres embarazadas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income families with young children (birth to age 5) and expecting families. Exact income rules were not stated on the page.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias de bajos ingresos con niños pequeños (desde que nacen hasta los 5 años) y familias que esperan un bebé. La página no dice las reglas exactas de ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through GETCAP's Head Start enrollment portal, or call or visit the Head Start center in your county.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite por internet en el portal de inscripción de Head Start de GETCAP, o llame o visite el centro de Head Start de su condado.
records.notes: Nacogdoches center: 1902 Old Tyler Road, Nacogdoches, TX 75964, (936) 564-1142. Full-day Early Head Start is offered at select Nacogdoches County locations.

records.name: Home Matters (Rent, Utility and Food Assistance)
records.description_en: Helps pay rent, utilities and food for people facing a temporary hardship. Also offers rental housing counseling (including tenant rights and the eviction process), first-time homebuyer education and free tax preparation.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar renta, servicios públicos y comida a personas con un problema económico temporal. También ofrece consejería sobre vivienda de renta (incluyendo sus derechos como inquilino y el proceso de desalojo), clases para comprar su primera casa y preparación de impuestos gratis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in Catholic Charities' nine-county Southeast Texas service area (including Jefferson County) facing a temporary hardship.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas en los nueve condados del Sureste de Texas que atiende Catholic Charities (incluye el condado de Jefferson) que pasan por un problema económico temporal.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Client Service Representative to discuss your situation and learn which documents you need.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la representante de servicio al cliente para hablar de su situación y saber qué papeles necesita.
records.notes: Main line (409) 924-4400. Program coordinator (409) 924-4420. First-time homebuyer program (409) 924-4415. Live counseling and classes are free; online homebuyer education costs $99. Languages offered were not stated on the page.

records.name: Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8) - City of Tyler
records.description_en: Helps very low-income families, seniors and people with disabilities pay rent for safe housing. The city also runs first-time homebuyer and home repair programs.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de muy bajos ingresos, personas mayores y personas con discapacidad a pagar la renta de una vivienda segura. La ciudad también tiene programas para comprar su primera casa y para reparar casas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Very low-income families, elderly and disabled people. The waiting list is currently closed.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias de muy bajos ingresos, personas mayores y personas con discapacidad. La lista de espera está cerrada por ahora.
records.how_to_apply: The voucher waiting list is closed. Check your existing application status at assistancecheck.com or waitlistcheck.com, or contact Neighborhood Services.
records.how_to_apply_es: La lista de espera de vales está cerrada. Puede revisar el estado de su solicitud en assistancecheck.com o waitlistcheck.com, o comunicarse con Neighborhood Services.
records.notes: Waitlist CLOSED as of this check (random selection from applications submitted by June 26, 2025 completed). TDHCA also lists Tyler Housing Authority at the same number.

records.name: Beaumont Housing Authority
records.description_en: Provides public housing and Housing Choice Vouchers (Section 8), plus Family Self-Sufficiency, homeownership help and services for elderly and disabled residents.
records.description_es: Ofrece vivienda pública y vales de vivienda (Sección 8), además de programas de autosuficiencia familiar, ayuda para comprar casa y servicios para personas mayores y con discapacidad.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income households who meet the housing authority's income limits and eligibility rules (posted on its website).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias de bajos ingresos que cumplen con los límites de ingresos y las reglas de la autoridad de vivienda (están en su página web).
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the authority's RentCafe portal when waiting lists are open, or call the office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite por internet en el portal RentCafe de la autoridad cuando las listas de espera estén abiertas, o llame a la oficina.
records.notes: Waitlist status was not shown on the page; call to confirm. TDHCA lists (409) 951-7207.

records.name: Port Arthur Housing Authority
records.description_en: Public housing agency in Port Arthur that offers subsidized housing, including Housing Choice Vouchers (Section 8).
records.description_es: Agencia pública de vivienda en Port Arthur que ofrece vivienda con ayuda para la renta, incluyendo vales de vivienda (Sección 8).
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income individuals and families; call for current rules and waitlist status.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas y familias de bajos ingresos. Llame para saber las reglas actuales y si la lista de espera está abierta.
records.how_to_apply: Call the housing authority to ask whether waiting lists are open and how to apply.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la autoridad de vivienda para preguntar si las listas de espera están abiertas y cómo solicitar.
records.notes: The authority's website blocked automated checks, so the phone was confirmed through TDHCA's Help for Texans directory. Address and waitlist status were not confirmed; call first. Relay Texas: 1-800-735-2989.

records.name: Deep East Texas Regional Housing Authority - Housing Choice Voucher
records.organization: Deep East Texas Council of Governments (DETCOG)
records.description_en: Runs a Housing Choice Voucher program that helps about 1,800 households in Deep East Texas pay rent, plus VASH vouchers for homeless veterans, Foster Youth to Independence and homeownership help.
records.description_es: Tiene un programa de vales de vivienda que ayuda a unas 1,800 familias del Este Profundo de Texas a pagar la renta. También tiene vales VASH para veteranos sin hogar, ayuda para jóvenes que salen de cuidado de crianza y ayuda para comprar casa.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income families in the DETCOG housing jurisdiction. Preference goes to families who live or work in the area, veterans, domestic violence survivors and families with a disabled member.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias de bajos ingresos en el área de vivienda de DETCOG. Tienen preferencia las familias que viven o trabajan en el área, los veteranos, las víctimas de violencia doméstica y las familias con una persona con discapacidad.
records.how_to_apply: Call or email the housing authority, or visit dethousing.org for waiting list details.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un email a la autoridad de vivienda, o visite dethousing.org para ver la información de la lista de espera.
records.notes: Email housing@detcog.gov. The authority keeps a waiting list (see dethousing.org). Its jurisdiction includes Angelina County, with some local exclusions; Nacogdoches County has its own housing authority.

records.name: Nacogdoches Housing Authority
records.description_en: Local public housing authority listed by the state for rent payment help in Nacogdoches County.
records.description_es: Autoridad de vivienda pública local que el estado incluye como fuente de ayuda para pagar la renta en el condado de Nacogdoches.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income Nacogdoches County residents; contact the authority for current rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de bajos ingresos del condado de Nacogdoches. Comuníquese con la autoridad para saber las reglas actuales.
records.how_to_apply: Call the housing authority to ask about openings and how to apply.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la autoridad de vivienda para preguntar si hay lugares disponibles y cómo solicitar.
records.notes: Confirmed via TDHCA's Help for Texans provider directory only (listings are self-reported). Address, hours and waitlist status not confirmed; call first.

records.name: Longview Housing Assistance Program
records.description_en: Local program listed by the state for rent payment help in Longview.
records.description_es: Programa local que el estado incluye como fuente de ayuda para pagar la renta en Longview.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income Longview/Gregg County residents; contact the program for rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de bajos ingresos de Longview y el condado de Gregg. Comuníquese con el programa para saber las reglas.
records.how_to_apply: Call the program to ask about openings and how to apply.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al programa para preguntar si hay lugares disponibles y cómo solicitar.
records.notes: Confirmed via TDHCA's Help for Texans directory only (listings are self-reported). TDHCA also lists the City of Longview Department of Housing and Community Development at (903) 237-1241. Call first.

records.name: City of Beaumont Housing and Community Services
records.description_en: City of Beaumont division (part of Community Development) listed by the state as a source of housing and emergency help for Beaumont residents.
records.description_es: División de la Ciudad de Beaumont (parte de Desarrollo Comunitario) que el estado incluye como fuente de ayuda de vivienda y de emergencia para residentes de Beaumont.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Beaumont residents with low income; contact the department for current programs and rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes de Beaumont con bajos ingresos. Comuníquese con la oficina para saber qué programas y reglas hay ahora.
records.how_to_apply: Call the department to ask what help is currently available.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina para preguntar qué ayuda hay disponible en este momento.
records.notes: Phone from the City of Beaumont staff directory (Housing and Community Services Division). TDHCA's directory lists an older number, (409) 880-3763. City of Port Arthur Housing Department (TDHCA listing): (409) 983-8259. Programs and rules not confirmed; call first.

records.name: Hiway 80 Rescue Mission
records.description_en: Emergency shelter, meals, showers, clothing, case management and recovery programs for people who are homeless or in crisis. Also offers a day resource center and long-term transitional living.
records.description_es: Refugio de emergencia, comidas, regaderas, ropa, apoyo de un trabajador de casos y programas de recuperación para personas sin hogar o en crisis. También tiene un centro de recursos de día y vivienda de transición a largo plazo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Men, women and children experiencing homelessness, crisis, addiction, abuse or poverty.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Hombres, mujeres y niños sin hogar, o que pasan por una crisis, adicción, abuso o pobreza.
records.how_to_apply: Call or go to the mission to ask about shelter and services.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o vaya a la misión para preguntar por refugio y servicios.
records.notes: Christ-centered ministry since 1955. Main shelter in Longview. Gateway to Hope day resource center and Triumph Village transitional living are in Tyler. Hours not listed.

records.name: The Salvation Army of Tyler
records.description_en: Local Salvation Army corps that offers shelter and community support to people in need in Tyler.
records.description_es: El Ejército de Salvación local ofrece refugio y apoyo a personas necesitadas en Tyler.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in need in the Tyler area; call for current services and rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas necesitadas en el área de Tyler. Llame para saber qué servicios hay y cuáles son las reglas.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Tyler Corps to ask about shelter and assistance.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite el Ejército de Salvación de Tyler para preguntar por refugio y ayuda.
records.notes: The page lists shelter as an area of focus but does not detail specific programs or hours; call first.

records.name: The Salvation Army of Lufkin
records.description_en: Local Salvation Army offering food assistance and community services. Veterans can ask about help with utilities and rent.
records.description_es: El Ejército de Salvación local ofrece ayuda con comida y servicios comunitarios. Los veteranos pueden preguntar por ayuda con servicios públicos y renta.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in need in the Lufkin area. Utility and rent help mentioned on the page is for veterans.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas necesitadas en el área de Lufkin. La ayuda con servicios públicos y renta es para veteranos.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Lufkin office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina de Lufkin.
records.notes: Veterans should contact the main office about emergency utility and rent help. Family Store: 205 E. Jodie Ave, (936) 634-7212, Mon-Sat 10 a.m.-5 p.m.

records.name: Tyler Transit (Bus, ParaTransit and MicroTransit)
records.description_en: City bus service with half-price fares for seniors, Medicare holders and people with disabilities. Also offers ParaTransit shared rides and on-demand MicroTransit.
records.description_es: Servicio de autobús de la ciudad con tarifa a mitad de precio para personas mayores, personas con Medicare y personas con discapacidad. También ofrece viajes compartidos ParaTransit y MicroTransit a pedido.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone can ride. Reduced $0.50 fare for seniors 65+, Medicare card holders and people with disabilities with proof of eligibility.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona puede usarlo. Las personas de 65 años o más, con tarjeta de Medicare o con discapacidad pagan $0.50 si muestran prueba.
documents_needed: Proof of age, Medicare card or disability (for reduced fare)
records.how_to_apply: Pay exact change on the bus (drivers do not carry change), buy passes online through Token Transit, or buy them at the Transit Depot. Bring proof of eligibility for the reduced fare.
records.how_to_apply_es: Pague el cambio exacto en el autobús (los choferes no dan cambio), compre pases por internet con Token Transit o en el Transit Depot. Traiga su prueba para la tarifa reducida.
records.cost: Adult $1.00; seniors 65+/Medicare/disabled $0.50; children 6-11 $0.50; 5 and under free; all-day pass $2
records.notes: Monthly pass $40 ($20 reduced fare); weekly pass $10 ($5 reduced fare). Tickets do not expire.

records.name: Longview Transit (Bus and Paratransit)
records.description_en: City bus service with reduced fares for seniors, Medicare holders and people with disabilities, plus ADA paratransit rides for people who cannot use the bus.
records.description_es: Servicio de autobús de la ciudad con tarifa reducida para personas mayores, personas con Medicare y personas con discapacidad, y viajes de paratránsito para quienes no pueden usar el autobús.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone can ride. Reduced $0.60 fare for seniors over 60, Medicare holders or people with a documented disability who get an MSD pass. Paratransit is for people whose disability keeps them from using fixed-route buses.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona puede usarlo. Pagan $0.60 las personas mayores de 60 años, con Medicare o con una discapacidad documentada que tengan el pase MSD. El paratránsito es para personas que, por su discapacidad, no pueden usar las rutas regulares.
documents_needed: Photo ID (for MSD reduced-fare pass; photo taken in person)
MSD application completed by a licensed healthcare professional (for disability)
records.how_to_apply: For reduced fare, get an MSD application at the Transit Administration Office (908 Pacific Ave.) or online, bring photo ID, and have your photo taken. For paratransit, get the application at 908 Pacific Ave., Suite 200, or by calling ext. 10; a healthcare provider completes the physician form. Decisions take up to 21 days.
records.how_to_apply_es: Para la tarifa reducida, pida la solicitud MSD en la oficina de Transit (908 Pacific Ave.) o por internet, traiga una identificación con foto y tómese la foto ahí. Para paratránsito, pida la solicitud en 908 Pacific Ave., Suite 200, o llamando a la extensión 10; su proveedor de salud llena el formulario médico. La decisión tarda hasta 21 días.
records.cost: Regular $1.25; seniors/Medicare/disabled $0.60; children 6-14 $0.65; day pass $3; paratransit $2.50 per trip
records.notes: Paratransit hours Mon-Fri 6 a.m.-7 p.m., Sat 7 a.m.-7 p.m.; book up to 14 days ahead at (903) 753-2287 ext. 10 (weekdays 8 a.m.-5 p.m.). TTY (903) 753-5265. Monthly pass $40.

records.name: Beaumont Municipal Transit (ZIP)
records.description_en: City bus service with reduced fares for seniors, youth and people with disabilities, free rides for veterans, and paratransit vans for ADA-eligible riders.
records.description_es: Servicio de autobús de la ciudad con tarifas reducidas para personas mayores, jóvenes y personas con discapacidad, viajes gratis para veteranos y camionetas de paratránsito para personas que califican bajo la ley ADA.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone can ride. Seniors 65+ with a Medicare card, youth 6-18, and disabled riders with a Beaumont ID pay $0.75. Veterans ride free with a Veterans Pass application. Paratransit is for ADA-qualified riders.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona puede usarlo. Pagan $0.75 las personas de 65 años o más con tarjeta de Medicare, los jóvenes de 6 a 18 años y las personas con discapacidad con identificación de Beaumont. Los veteranos viajan gratis si llenan la solicitud del pase para veteranos.
records.how_to_apply: Pay exact fare on the bus or buy passes at 550 Milam Street or Central Collections at City Hall (801 Main Street).
records.how_to_apply_es: Pague el cambio exacto en el autobús o compre pases en 550 Milam Street o en Central Collections del Ayuntamiento (801 Main Street).
records.cost: Adult $1.50; youth/senior/disabled $0.75; veterans free; paratransit $2.50 per ride or $80 monthly
records.notes: Drivers do not carry change. Unlimited passes: 1-day $3, 7-day $12, 31-day $40 (reduced $2.25/$9/$30). A Student Mobility Pass is available.

records.name: GoBus Rural Transit
records.description_en: Demand-response public transportation for rural East Texas, including rides to appointments. Free rides for veterans and active military, including trips to the Overton Brooks VA in Shreveport.
records.description_es: Transporte público a pedido para las zonas rurales del Este de Texas, incluyendo viajes a citas. Viajes gratis para veteranos y militares activos, incluso al hospital de veteranos Overton Brooks en Shreveport.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the general public in the non-urbanized (rural) parts of Smith and Gregg counties and 12 other East Texas counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto al público en las zonas rurales de los condados de Smith y Gregg y en 12 condados más del Este de Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Call to book at least 24 hours ahead (up to two weeks ahead), or request a trip online. Have your pickup and drop-off addresses and travel times ready. New riders do a short intake by phone.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para reservar por lo menos 24 horas antes (hasta dos semanas antes), o pida su viaje por internet. Tenga listas las direcciones de salida y llegada y las horas del viaje. Si es su primera vez, le harán unas preguntas por teléfono.
records.cost: $2 per trip, $1 per additional stop; free for veterans and active military
records.notes: Serves only non-urbanized areas of Smith and Gregg; inside Tyler and Longview use city transit. The GoBus website lists dispatch at (903) 215-8870.

records.name: Brazos Transit District - Lufkin and Nacogdoches
records.description_en: Fixed-route buses, ADA paratransit and demand-response rides in Lufkin and Nacogdoches.
records.description_es: Autobuses con rutas fijas, paratránsito y viajes a pedido en Lufkin y Nacogdoches.
records.eligibility_summary_en: General public; ADA paratransit is for eligible people with disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Público en general. El paratránsito es para personas con discapacidad que califican.
records.how_to_apply: New riders call the Dispatch Center to book paratransit or demand-response trips; existing customers can book online at portal.btd.org.
records.how_to_apply_es: Si es nuevo, llame al centro de despacho para reservar viajes de paratránsito o a pedido. Si ya es cliente, puede reservar por internet en portal.btd.org.
records.cost: Fares vary; cash and major credit cards accepted
records.notes: Dispatch also (979) 778-4480. Customer service (979) 778-0607 ext 7008. DETCOG refers Deep East Texas residents to BTD for public transit. Fare amounts not confirmed.

records.name: South East Texas Transit (SETT)
records.organization: South East Texas Regional Planning Commission
records.description_en: Demand-response rides in rural western Jefferson County, and rides for seniors and people with disabilities in Groves, Port Neches and Nederland.
records.description_es: Viajes a pedido en la zona rural del oeste del condado de Jefferson, y viajes para personas mayores y personas con discapacidad en Groves, Port Neches y Nederland.
records.eligibility_summary_en: General public in rural western Jefferson County; seniors 65+ and people with disabilities in Mid-Jefferson County cities.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Público en general en la zona rural del oeste del condado de Jefferson; personas de 65 años o más y personas con discapacidad en las ciudades del centro del condado.
records.how_to_apply: Call ahead to schedule; advance notice is required.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame con anticipación para programar su viaje.
records.cost: See service brochure; fares vary by area
records.notes: Mid-County and Rural Jefferson scheduling: (800) 259-4457 or (409) 892-0979. Medicare-eligible clients may qualify for more options through 2-1-1.

records.name: Workforce Solutions East Texas
records.description_en: Free job search help, job placement, training and hiring events, with workforce centers in Tyler and Longview and mobile centers for rural areas. Special programs for veterans, young adults and people with disabilities.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, colocación en empleos, capacitación y ferias de empleo, con centros en Tyler y Longview y centros móviles para zonas rurales. Hay programas especiales para veteranos, jóvenes adultos y personas con discapacidad.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job seekers and employers in 14 East Texas counties, including Smith and Gregg.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que buscan trabajo y empleadores en 14 condados del Este de Texas, incluyendo Smith y Gregg.
records.how_to_apply: Call the regional line or visit a workforce center. Search jobs on WorkInTexas.com.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea regional o visite un centro de empleo. Busque trabajos en WorkInTexas.com.
records.notes: Phone is 1-844-ETWORKS. Centers in Athens, Longview, Marshall, Palestine and Tyler (street addresses not confirmed). Email callcentermailbox@easttexasworkforce.org.

records.name: Child Care Services - Workforce Solutions East Texas
records.description_en: Helps eligible families pay for child care so parents can work, go to school or train.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias que califican a pagar el cuidado de niños para que los padres puedan trabajar, estudiar o capacitarse.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Eligible low-income families in the 14-county East Texas workforce area, including Smith and Gregg. Income limits were not stated on the page.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias de bajos ingresos que califican en los 14 condados del área, incluyendo Smith y Gregg. La página no dice los límites de ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Call Workforce Solutions East Texas or visit childcare.easttexasworkforce.org/etc to learn about applying for child care financial aid.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Workforce Solutions East Texas o visite childcare.easttexasworkforce.org/etc para saber cómo solicitar ayuda para pagar el cuidado de niños.
records.notes: Serves Anderson, Camp, Cherokee, Gregg, Harrison, Henderson, Marion, Panola, Rains, Rusk, Smith, Upshur, Van Zandt and Wood counties.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Deep East Texas - Angelina County (Lufkin)
records.description_en: Free career planning, job matching, resume and interview help, and access to training.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para planear su carrera, encontrar trabajo, hacer su currículum y prepararse para entrevistas, y acceso a capacitación.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job seekers in Angelina County and the surrounding Deep East Texas area.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que buscan trabajo en el condado de Angelina y el área del Este Profundo de Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center during business hours or call.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro en horario de oficina o llame.
records.notes: Relay Texas: 1-800-735-2989 (TDD) or 1-800-735-2988 (Voice). Text DETX to 936-251-6022 for job alerts.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Deep East Texas - Nacogdoches County
records.description_en: Free career planning, job matching, resume and interview help, and access to training.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para planear su carrera, encontrar trabajo, hacer su currículum y prepararse para entrevistas, y acceso a capacitación.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job seekers in Nacogdoches County and the surrounding area.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que buscan trabajo en el condado de Nacogdoches y el área cercana.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center during business hours or call.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro en horario de oficina o llame.

records.name: Child Care Services - Workforce Solutions Deep East Texas
records.description_en: Temporary financial aid to help eligible families pay for child care. Families pay a co-payment based on income and household size.
records.description_es: Ayuda temporal para que familias que califican paguen el cuidado de niños. La familia paga una parte (copago) según sus ingresos y el tamaño de su hogar.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families in Angelina, Houston, Jasper, Nacogdoches, Polk and Shelby counties with a child under 13 (or under 19 with a disability). Parents must work, go to school or train at least 25 hours a week (50 combined for two parents) and meet income limits.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias en los condados de Angelina, Houston, Jasper, Nacogdoches, Polk y Shelby con un niño menor de 13 años (o menor de 19 con discapacidad). Los padres deben trabajar, estudiar o capacitarse por lo menos 25 horas a la semana (50 entre los dos padres) y cumplir con los límites de ingresos.
documents_needed: Proof of U.S. citizenship or valid immigration status (for the child)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Texas Child Care Connection (TX3C) parent portal. See the Parents page on detwork.org, or call or email child care services.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite por internet en el portal para padres Texas Child Care Connection (TX3C). Vea la página para padres en detwork.org, o llame o mande un email a servicios de cuidado infantil.
records.cost: Co-payment based on income and household size
records.notes: Email ccsdet@detwork.org. Income limits are posted in a table on the Parents page. Local centers: Lufkin (936) 639-1351; Nacogdoches (936) 560-1441.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Southeast Texas
records.description_en: Free job search and placement, skills training, youth programs (ages 16-24), veteran services, and child care services.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo y colocación en empleos, capacitación, programas para jóvenes (de 16 a 24 años), servicios para veteranos y servicios de cuidado de niños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job seekers and families in Jefferson, Orange and Hardin counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que buscan trabajo y familias en los condados de Jefferson, Orange y Hardin.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Beaumont or Port Arthur workforce center, or call the main line.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro de empleo de Beaumont o Port Arthur, o llame a la línea principal.
records.notes: Main line (877) 834-5627. Port Arthur center: 4680 FM 365, Port Arthur, TX 77642, (409) 962-1236.

records.name: Andrews Behavioral Health (Andrews Center)
records.description_en: Local mental health authority offering crisis services, adult and youth mental health care, substance use treatment, IDD and autism services, and veteran services. Runs a Diversion Center in Tyler for crisis stabilization.
records.description_es: Autoridad local de salud mental que ofrece servicios de crisis, atención de salud mental para adultos y jóvenes, tratamiento para el uso de sustancias, servicios para discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo y autismo, y servicios para veteranos. Tiene un Centro de Desvío en Tyler para estabilizar crisis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Residents of Henderson, Rains, Smith, Van Zandt and Wood counties, especially people who are underserved.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes de los condados de Henderson, Rains, Smith, Van Zandt y Wood, especialmente personas que no reciben suficiente atención.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Tyler clinic to request services. In a crisis call the 24/7 hotline or 988.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica de Tyler para pedir servicios. En una crisis, llame a la línea de 24 horas o al 988.
records.notes: 24/7 crisis hotline: (877) 934-2131. Diversion Center: 3111 North Northwest Loop 323, Tyler, TX 75702. Fee details not stated on the page; ask when you call.

records.name: Community Healthcore
records.description_en: Certified community behavioral health clinic offering mental health, substance use, crisis, IDD, primary care, veteran and supportive housing services.
records.description_es: Clínica comunitaria certificada de salud del comportamiento que ofrece servicios de salud mental, uso de sustancias, crisis, discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo, atención médica primaria, veteranos y vivienda con apoyo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children, teens, adults and veterans in its service area, including Gregg County. No one is denied services for inability to pay.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños, adolescentes, adultos y veteranos en su área, incluyendo el condado de Gregg. A nadie le niegan servicios por no poder pagar.
records.how_to_apply: Call the services line for referrals or visit a Longview location.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de servicios para pedir una referencia o visite una de sus oficinas en Longview.
records.cost: Sliding fee scale based on family size and income; no one denied for inability to pay
records.notes: 24/7 crisis line: (800) 832-1009. Administrative office: 107 Woodbine Place, (903) 758-2471. Adult mental health and primary care: 1300 North Sixth Street, Longview, (903) 297-1852. Children and adolescent services: 3110 H.G. Mosley Pkwy, Suite 104, (903) 234-9200. Substance use: 950 North Fourth Street, (903) 758-0596.

records.name: Burke (Mental Health and IDD Services)
records.description_en: Local mental health and developmental disability provider offering adult and child mental health care, substance use services, IDD services, early childhood intervention (birth to 3) and veteran support.
records.description_es: Proveedor local de servicios de salud mental y discapacidades del desarrollo. Ofrece salud mental para adultos y niños, servicios para el uso de sustancias, servicios de discapacidad intelectual y del desarrollo, intervención temprana para bebés (de 0 a 3 años) y apoyo para veteranos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Residents of Burke's 11-county area, which includes Angelina and Nacogdoches counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes de los 11 condados que atiende Burke, incluyendo Angelina y Nacogdoches.
records.how_to_apply: Call the mental health services line to request services. In a crisis call the 24-hour hotline.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de servicios de salud mental para pedir ayuda. En una crisis, llame a la línea de 24 horas.
records.notes: 24-hour crisis hotline: 1-800-392-8343. Toll free services line (866) 242-4556. Early Childhood Intervention: (936) 634-4703. Street address and fees were not stated on the page.

records.name: Spindletop Center
records.description_en: Behavioral health center in Beaumont offering mental health care, substance use recovery, IDD services, early childhood intervention and crisis services.
records.description_es: Centro de salud del comportamiento en Beaumont que ofrece salud mental, recuperación del uso de sustancias, servicios de discapacidad del desarrollo, intervención temprana para niños pequeños y servicios de crisis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People needing behavioral health care in the Beaumont area. No one is turned away for inability to pay.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que necesitan atención de salud del comportamiento en el área de Beaumont. A nadie le niegan servicios por no poder pagar.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main number to ask about services. In a crisis call the 24-hour hotline.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al número principal para preguntar por los servicios. En una crisis, llame a la línea de 24 horas.
records.cost: Sliding fee scale based on family size and income; no one turned away for inability to pay
records.notes: 24-hour crisis hotline: 1-800-937-8097. Toll free: 1-800-317-5809. The page did not list its full county service area.

records.name: Wellness Pointe
records.description_en: Community health clinics offering family medicine, pediatrics, women's health, dental, vision and behavioral health, plus WIC, parenting and home visiting programs and help enrolling in health insurance.
records.description_es: Clínicas de salud comunitarias con medicina familiar, pediatría, salud de la mujer, dental, visión y salud del comportamiento. También tienen WIC, programas para padres, visitas al hogar y ayuda para inscribirse en un seguro médico.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Patients in Northeast Texas, with clinics in Longview and a women's health center in Tyler.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Pacientes del Noreste de Texas, con clínicas en Longview y un centro de salud de la mujer en Tyler.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main number to make an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al número principal para hacer una cita.
records.notes: Toll free (888) 811-6648. Tyler Women's Health Center: 825 Medical Drive. Other Longview clinics: 425 N Fredonia St, 2131 Mobberly Ave, 1761 W Loop 281, 802 Medical Circle.

records.name: Lone Star Legal Aid - East and Southeast Texas Offices
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income Texans, for example with eviction, family law, public benefits, consumer, employment and domestic violence problems.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis en casos civiles para personas de bajos ingresos en Texas, por ejemplo con desalojos, asuntos de familia, beneficios públicos, problemas de consumidor, trabajo y violencia doméstica.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income people who meet financial and legal status rules. Civil cases only, no criminal cases.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de bajos ingresos que cumplen con las reglas de ingresos y de estatus legal. Solo casos civiles, no casos criminales.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online any time (24/7) or call the toll-free intake line.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite por internet a cualquier hora (24/7) o llame a la línea gratuita de admisión.
records.notes: Beaumont office serves Jefferson; Longview office serves Gregg; Tyler office serves Smith; Nacogdoches office serves Angelina and Nacogdoches. Exact income limit not stated on the site. Statewide eviction help also at texaslawhelp.org/eviction-referral or (855) 270-7655.

records.name: Area Agency on Aging of East Texas
records.description_en: Senior nutrition (meals), benefits counseling, care coordination, caregiver support, ombudsman help and health and wellness programs for older adults.
records.description_es: Comidas para personas mayores, consejería sobre beneficios, coordinación de cuidados, apoyo para cuidadores, ayuda del ombudsman y programas de salud y bienestar para adultos mayores.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People age 60 and older, and their caregivers, in 14 East Texas counties, including Smith and Gregg.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de 60 años o más, y sus cuidadores, en 14 condados del Este de Texas, incluyendo Smith y Gregg.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Area Agency on Aging to ask for services.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la Agencia del Área para Personas Mayores para pedir servicios.
records.notes: Local (903) 218-6500. Tyler satellite office: 100 E Ferguson St, Tyler, TX 75702. Website: www.EastTexasAAA.org.

records.name: Area Agency on Aging of Deep East Texas
records.organization: Deep East Texas Council of Governments (DETCOG)
records.description_en: Congregate and home-delivered meals, benefits counseling for Medicare, Medicaid and Social Security, caregiver support, care coordination and ombudsman help.
records.description_es: Comidas en grupo y a domicilio, consejería sobre Medicare, Medicaid y Seguro Social, apoyo para cuidadores, coordinación de cuidados y ayuda del ombudsman.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People age 60 and older in Deep East Texas; the Aging and Disability Resource Center serves people of any age with disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de 60 años o más en el Este Profundo de Texas. El Centro de Recursos para Personas Mayores y con Discapacidad (ADRC) atiende a personas de cualquier edad con discapacidad.
records.how_to_apply: Call the agency to request services.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la agencia para pedir servicios.
records.notes: Also (409) 384-7614. More info at www.aaadeepeasttx.org. DETCOG region includes Angelina and Nacogdoches counties.

records.name: Area Agency on Aging - Southeast Texas
records.organization: South East Texas Regional Planning Commission
records.description_en: Senior meals and transportation (through local partners), benefits counseling, care coordination, caregiver support and ombudsman services for older adults.
records.description_es: Comidas y transporte para personas mayores (por medio de organizaciones locales), consejería sobre beneficios, coordinación de cuidados, apoyo para cuidadores y servicios del ombudsman.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Older adults in Hardin, Jefferson and Orange counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Adultos mayores en los condados de Hardin, Jefferson y Orange.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Area Agency on Aging to ask for services.
